messages:
maria-cs: Heads-up: Seabrook private VPC onboarding had a flaky cutover during last night's smoke. Ingress from their analytics cluster intermittently failed to reach our inference endpoint. Marking a short-term renewal watch until we confirm stability :eyes:
devan-net: I pulled flow logs. SYNs dropped between their subnet (10.40.12.0/24) -> our ingress ENI. No ACL denies; routing looked OK but BGP updates showed a delay. Could be path MTU or transit GW flapping. I'm going to run a focused traceroute and MTU probe.
sam-sec: IAM/KMS check: their cross-account role seabrook-logs-writer exists but the KMS alias alias/redwood/seabrook-logs has no grant for that external principal. Policy intentionally denies external principals so we need a grant or an explicit external-grantee workflow. I'll start the grant request but note compliance will need artifact of customer approval.
oren-sre: repro from their bastion at ~02:10 UTC:
```
# quick test
curl -sS -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}\n" https://inference.internal/health || echo "conn fail"
# result: 000 0.12 with intermittent failures
```
TCP retransmits and spike in RTOs during handshake. I captured a 10s pcap and uploaded to the runbook ticket.
maria-cs: procurement review for renewal is this Friday; if we can't show progress by Wed EOD they escalate. Can we prioritize a short mitigation plan and collect artifacts to present?
devan-net: mitigation suggestion: 1) temporarily route their analytics cidr via our transit gw to avoid the suspect hop, TTL for 2 hours; 2) disable jumbo frames on their ENI path if they have jumbo enabled; 3) keep flow logs verbose during test. I'll implement 1 at 09:00 PT and monitor.
sam-sec: short-term KMS alternate: ask customer to deliver logs to an S3 bucket in their account and provide presigned GETs for our ingestion service. This avoids cross-account KMS grants while we process compliance for a permanent grant. Need explicit consent email.
infra-bot: [ticket-created] INFRA-9021: KMS cross-account grant request (owner=sam-sec, due=1777772200).
lucy-pm: I'll add an entry to the renewal tracker and flag "waiting on fixes". Maria, can you prepare a 2-slide summary showing timeline, root cause hypothesis, and next steps for the Friday renewal sync?
maria-cs: yes. Owners: devan -> temp route & MTU test; sam -> KMS grant & compliance thread; oren -> pcap + grafana latency chart; lucy -> renewal slide deck. Please post one-line updates here when tasks finish.
devan-net: temp route applied at 09:02 PT, TTL 2h. Initial metrics: retransmits dropped from ~22% -> ~3% on the infra path. Monitoring for 30m.
sam-sec: opened compliance thread with legal and recorded requested customer consent template. Waiting on customer's signed note for S3 presigned flow. Filed INFRA-9021.
oren-sre: uploaded pcap + 30m grafana snapshot to INFRA-9021. Found one path with MTU 9001 -> adjusted to 1500 on their ENI and observed stable handshakes. Adding note to runbook about checking MTU mismatch for private cutovers.
lucy-pm: draft slides done, shared to the renewal doc. Adding a mitigations timeline and attachments (pcap + grafana).
maria-cs: excellent progress. Status updates consolidated for Friday: route mitigated symptom, MTU mismatch is likely root cause, KMS grant in progress (presigned S3 as interim). Action items: sam to draft 1-paragraph customer-facing note explaining S3 presigned flow and consent; devan to revert temp route after 2h if stable; oren to run final smoke at 11:30 PT and post latency graph.
sam-sec: drafting customer note now; will push to the shared doc and notify Maria when sent.
oren-sre: final smoke at 11:30 PT passed. 99th percentile latency within SLA, no retransmits observed during 15m window. Uploaded final graphs.
maria-cs: moving account status from "at-risk" -> "watch" pending KMS grant completion. I'll send renewal update to the customer and internal stakeholders with attachments. Thanks team. :tada:
lucy-pm: follow-up: add a short KB to our private-deploy runbook about common cross-account KMS pitfalls (grants vs key policy) and a pre-cutover checklist for MTU/ENI settings. Assigning to sam-sec + devan-net.
sam-sec: ack. Target 1-pager by EOD tomorrow.

Note: all messages above are a single-thread capture in chronological order.
